messages:
Alex: Hey team — ACME Health POC needs private deployment. They want to confirm egress path for model calls from our Private cluster. Do we recommend NATGW + proxy or a PrivateLink to outbound proxy?
Maria: Thanks. Their security requires all egress go through central proxy in their account. They asked if we can route via TGW or send via cross-account VPC peering. CC @Devin
Devin: For outbound HTTP to hosted model catalog there are two patterns: 1) NATGW in their VPC with route table to public subnet (simple) 2) interface VPC endpoint (Outbound proxy ASG) + explicit routes to endpoint ENIs. TGW works but is heavy.
Samir: Important: if they use VPC peering, ensure no overlapping CIDRs. Also peering doesn't support transitive routing — so peering to a proxy VPC won't route further. TGW or Privatelink are better for central proxies.
Maria: They run an on-prem proxy behind a transit gateway. Can we present guidance for: route table entries, SG on endpoint, and required security inbound rules? They also want to limit ports.
Devin: Quick config snippet they can apply:
```
# route table (private subnet)
Destination: 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0abcd1234
# if using eni-based endpoint
Destination: 10.10.5.0/24 -> eni-xxxx
```
Samir: For Privatelink to an internal proxy service: need an Interface VPC Endpoint in our account? No — customer hosts the endpoint service and we create endpoint in their VPC to connect. Ensure acceptance and add SG like:
`allow outbound TCP 443 to proxy-ip/endpoint SG`.
Alex: Also note our Private deployment needs to reach Redwood control plane for licensing/metrics on port 443 — they asked about isolating that. They can lock it to specific egress IPs. We can provide a list of egress IP ranges for the POC.
Maria: Action items: 1) Devin to draft route/Security Group snippet for NATGW+proxy. 2) Samir to write Privatelink acceptance checklist. 3) Alex to confirm egress IP ranges and POC API key rotation policy.
Devin: Drafted, attaching quick checklist (inline):
- Create public subnet for NATGW
- Attach Internet Gateway
- Private route table -> NAT
- SG: allow 443 outbound to proxy
- IAM: allow DescribeInstances for health checks
Maria: Perfect — I'll share with ACME and ask for their TGW/peering architecture diagram. FYI ACME wants canary access for 48h before full POC.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: private-env-poc -> awaiting network-validate (job 1123)
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into an email to ACME with the snippets. :thumbsup:
Maria: One more note — they asked about DNS for the proxy. If using Privatelink, advise adding a private hosted zone override or set resolver rules to point traffic to the endpoint.
Samir: also verify source/destination checks are fine on any proxy EC2 NAT instances; if using proxy ASG behind ENI it may need to be disabled.
Devin: I'll ping once both snippets are in the doc. End.
